title: bartschella glassii subsp. ascensionis
intro: Bartschella glassii subsp. ascensionis, commonly known as Ascension Island Bartsia, is a plant species native to the island of Ascension in the South Atlantic Ocean. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues, such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Ascension Island Bartsia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and medicinal properties.
